title: Why this chronicle matters now
summary: The point of the page is to argue that Koutian Wu's working research program — explainable AI inside physics-based Noah-MP, running on NSF NCAR Derecho-GPU — is a present-tense bet on AI for Earth system science, not a tidy CV.

signals.label: NSF NCAR allocation UTAA0012
signals.text: Project Administrator on NSF NCAR allocation UTAA0012, 'Explainable AI for Improving Physics-Based Noah-MP Land Surface Modeling of Plant–Rock–Water Interactions.' Significant HPC time on the NSF NCAR Derecho-GPU supercomputer.
